ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged failure of Minnesota's Department of Human Services to verify attendance records and pursue fraud tips, leading to a federal funding freeze.
questions: What specific actions led to the funding freeze?

ideas.insight: This story could uncover systemic issues within Minnesota's Medicaid program and potentially lead to further investigations and reforms.
